facts.statement: Eoconfuciusornis was an extinct bird-like animal that lived 131 million years ago in the Early Cretaceous period of China.
facts.quote: Eoconfuciusornis a genus of extinct avialan that lived 131 Ma ago, in the Early Cretaceous of China.

facts.statement: The species Eoconfuciusornis zhengi was named and described by Fucheng Zhang, Zhou Zhonghe, and Michael Benton in 2008.
facts.quote: The type species of Eoconfuciusornis, Eoconfuciusornis zhengi, was named and described by Fucheng Zhang, Zhou Zhonghe and Michael Benton in 2008.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Eoconfuciusornis was discovered near Sichakou in Fengning, Hebei province.
facts.quote: The holotype, specimen IVPP V11977, was found near Sichakou in Fengning in Hebei province.

facts.statement: Eoconfuciusornis is recognized as the oldest known bird possessing a beak.
facts.quote: It is the oldest known bird to have a beak.

facts.statement: Eoconfuciusornis was slightly smaller than Confuciusornis but shared a similar pointed, toothless beak.
facts.quote: Eoconfuciusornis was somewhat smaller than Confuciusornis, but otherwise very similar with a pointed toothless beak.

facts.statement: Eoconfuciusornis is classified within the family Confuciusornithidae.
facts.quote: Eoconfuciusornis was assigned to the Confuciusornithidae.

facts.statement: The feathers on the wing coverts, nape, and tail of Eoconfuciusornis were black, with a dark spotted pattern on the secondary flight feathers.
facts.quote: Feathers making up the wing coverts, nape, and tail were black, and a dark spotted pattern can be spotted on the secondary remiges.

facts.statement: Eoconfuciusornis had grey feathers on its hindlimbs and head, and brown feathers on its throat.
facts.quote: Feathers on the hindlimb and top of the head were grey, while those on the throat were brown.

facts.statement: The genus Eoconfuciusornis lived during the Hauterivian to Barremian stages, from 132.6 to 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Hauterivian to Barremian (132.6 to 121.4 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Unlike Confuciusornis, Eoconfuciusornis had longer legs and lacked a pierced deltopectoral crest on its humerus.
rejected.quote: Compared to the latter it had longer legs and lacked a pierced deltopectoral crest on the humerus.
